question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: **DELETERIOUS**
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Harmful.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **deleterious** means causing harm or damage.
 
• The synonym of **deleterious** is **harmful**, which matches its meaning.
 
• Options such as **useful, comforting, and helpful** are antonyms and do not fit the meaning of the word.

Correct sentence: *The synonym of **deleterious** is **harmful**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Deleterious** is often used to describe things that have negative effects on health, environment, or well-being.
 
• Example sentence: Smoking is deleterious to your health.
